stories.title: 8-year-old Haitian boy returns home after being detained by ICE in San Diego
stories.summary: The 8-year-old Haitian boy who ICE detained in San Diego nearly two weeks ago has been reunited with his family, advocates with Haitian Bridge Alliance said on Monday. The boy, a third grader at Fay Elementary School in City Heights, was taken into federal custody on Nov. 4. Vide
